final: SELECT p.bats, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) as player_count, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ma2.player_id) FROM manager_award ma2 JOIN player p2 ON ma2.player_id = p2.player_id) as proportion FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats
